items.description: Seedance 2.5 (Image-to-Video) generates Hollywood-grade cinematic videos from reference images and text prompts with native audio-visual synchronization, director-level camera and lighting control, and exceptional motion stability. Built on Seed's unified multimodal architecture, it preserves the input image's subject and composition while adding expressive, physically accurate motion.

Seedance 2.5 (Video-Edit) edits an input video from a natural-language prompt. The reference video drives subject identity, composition, and motion while the model rewrites lighting, style, weather, environment, or specific elements as instructed.
